labeling_strategies.labeling_details: The project states that a visualization and annotation environment will label data with targets important for prediction, and that it will develop capabilities across the multi-center network to acquire, standardize, tokenize, store, visualize and label data.
labeling_strategies.data_annotation_protocol: Clinical collaborators contribute to semantic mapping and validation under a clinical validation SOP associated with the chorus-mapping repository.
labeling_strategies.source_caveats: The annotation environment is described in the future tense in the award abstract and the GitHub organization overview; the bundle does not report labels present in the released data.

splits.split_details: The award abstract states that the dataset will also provision a holdout test set, accessible for model external validation to aid marketplace adoption of AI-developed models, and describes sequestering holdout datasets for external validation.
splits.source_caveats: Stated as a project intention in the 2022 award abstract; the bundle does not state the size, composition or availability of the holdout set.
